title: Unlocking the Pre-Trained Model as a Dual-Alignment Calibrator for Post-Trained LLMs

summary.claim: Overconfidence in post-trained models comes from confidence drift (only final confidence rises) and process drift (intermediate inference paths diverge). Dual-Align, an unsupervised method, fixes both against the pretrained model.
summary.condition: Pairs of post-trained LLMs and their pretrained models; post-hoc correction that learns a single temperature parameter.
summary.gap: (Inferred) It needs the pretrained model, so it is hard to use when the pretrained checkpoint is not released.
